decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of single storey 
            temporary kit bag storage unit to site  to the existing Fire Station,   
            because of  its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having   
             due  regard for the site characteristics of number 520 London Road 
            and is complementary to the visual amenity of the locality and would 
            not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring 
            properties or the Conservation Area.  The development is in 
            accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development)  and ENVB 2.2 
            (Conservation Areas) Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow 
            UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of single storey temporary kit bag storage unit to site
